profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary:
Experienced embedded systems developer. Some highlights:
 - Systems ranging from microcontrollers to multi-core servers
 - Bare metal, RTOS, and Linux environments
 - High speed Serdes & ethernet
 - Lightweight hypervisors & virtio

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: C++ · Go (Programming Language) · Gigabit Ethernet · Virtio · Protocol Buffers · Linux Kernel · FreeRTOS

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Technical lead for Engine Airframe System (GEA)
  ◦ Analog/Digital conversion for various engine instruments
  ◦ Led small team of 2-3 developers
  ◦ Responsible for code/design review and sprint planning
• Application developer for Sirius/XM datalink (GDL 69)
  ◦ Datalink to process weather and audio from satellite receiver
  ◦ Designed audio control subsystem to support multiple display clients
  ◦ Worked on algorithms to convert weather data between proprietary formats.

positions.title: Electrical Engineer
positions.description:
• Hardware Engineer on JTRS HMS program
◦ Handheld software defined radio for military application
◦ Developed microcontroller firmware to manage system power usage / battery
charging
◦  Pulled in to debug complex hardware/software issues
positions.insights: Skills: C · I2C · MSP430 · ARM · Device Drivers

positions.title: Student Researcher
positions.description: Analysed EEG datasets using time-frequency techniques to detect phase locking between two signals

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description: Wrote drivers and test suites for board verification and test on an embedded ARM processor.

positions.title: Computational Biology Intern
positions.description: Quantization of high dimensional microarray / gene expression data.

publications.title: Aquila: A unified, low-latency fabric for datacenter networks
